comment: In-game GATEWAY INFORMATION (GTWI) build cost transcription, ZV-307c and SE-648c, 2026-08-09. Costs are per GATE — one END of a link — so a link costs TWO of these, both ends bought separately. `base` is a gate at zero upgrades; `upgrades.*.unit` is the cost of the FIRST level of that upgrade. Upgrade cost is TRIANGULAR, not linear: the n-th level costs n x unit, so n levels cost unit * n*(n+1)/2. Effects, in contrast, are linear per level. Two caps apply at once: each track has its own maxLevel AND the three together may not exceed `totalUpgradeBudget`. Verified against 13 transcribed configurations across the two gates — single-track capacity 1/2/5, volume 1/2/3, range 1/2/3, and the mixed 5-point builds (0/3/2, 1/3/1, 0/2/3, 1/2/2, 2/2/1) — every material of every one reproducing exactly. `upkeep` is the panel's upkeep line, PER GATE and PER DAY, flat across every upgrade level — the panel never states the period, the daily reading is the user's (2026-08-09), reasoned from the scale: a few dozen ships paying 4,000-6,000 ȼ of gate fees a day comfortably covers it. Flatness is observed across all 13 configurations; the period is not.
